decisions.title: OPPORTUNITY_UNIT definition
decisions.question: Is an OPPORTUNITY one `(symbol, trading_date, session)` or one `(symbol, trading_date, session, boundary)`?
decisions.summary: Choose the denominator unit before replay.
options: (symbol, trading_date, session)
(symbol, trading_date, session, boundary)

consequences.option: (symbol, trading_date, session)
consequences.consequence: Keeps one opportunity per session and aligns with the 2.0.0 prototype denominator; opposite boundaries share one unit.

consequences.option: (symbol, trading_date, session, boundary)
consequences.consequence: Counts each boundary independently and can produce up to two opportunities per symbol-day-session; prior funnel denominators are not directly comparable.

decisions.title: CONTEXT_ELIGIBLE and LOCATION_ELIGIBLE predicate definitions
decisions.question: What predicate defines `CONTEXT_ELIGIBLE`, and what defines `LOCATION_ELIGIBLE`?
decisions.summary: Freeze both stage predicates before replay.
options: Define separate deterministic context and location predicates in an owner-approved contract amendment.
Retain the current predicates as unresolved and keep replay blocked.

consequences.option: Define separate deterministic context and location predicates in an owner-approved contract amendment.
consequences.consequence: A replay may be considered only after the amended predicates are preregistered and tested.

consequences.option: Retain the current predicates as unresolved and keep replay blocked.
consequences.consequence: No V2.1 replay or funnel denominator is authorized.

decisions.title: Initial branch selection and branch priority on a boundary interaction
decisions.question: Which branch is attempted first on a boundary interaction — decided by the interaction bar's close (prototype behaviour), by a fixed precedence, or are both run and the earlier `ENTRY_AVAILABLE` taken?
decisions.summary: Resolve initial branch assignment before replay.
options: Select the branch from the interaction bar close.
Use a fixed A/B precedence.
Evaluate both and take the earlier ENTRY_AVAILABLE.

consequences.option: Select the branch from the interaction bar close.
consequences.consequence: Branch assignment depends on close direction and must be fully specified for ties and handovers.

consequences.option: Use a fixed A/B precedence.
consequences.consequence: The preferred branch gets first claim on the event lock, potentially changing branch mix.

consequences.option: Evaluate both and take the earlier ENTRY_AVAILABLE.
consequences.consequence: Both branches compete for the lock; deterministic tie handling is required.

decisions.title: Prior-day and swing-liquidity target authority
decisions.question: Define "prior day" (previous calendar day vs previous trading day; UTC vs session day) and define the swing-liquidity derivation (timeframe, and whether `SWING_ORDER = 2` applies).
decisions.summary: Define both target authorities before replay.
options: Use previous calendar day in UTC and define swing liquidity on the contract's named timeframe with SWING_ORDER = 2.
Use previous trading/session day and owner-specify the swing-liquidity timeframe and swing order.

consequences.option: Use previous calendar day in UTC and define swing liquidity on the contract's named timeframe with SWING_ORDER = 2.
consequences.consequence: Produces calendar-day levels and a fixed swing derivation, which may differ at weekends and session boundaries.

consequences.option: Use previous trading/session day and owner-specify the swing-liquidity timeframe and swing order.
consequences.consequence: Requires an explicit session-day calendar and amended timeframe/order before any result can be generated.

decisions.title: Canonical session authority
decisions.question: Which session authority controls: governed V0.3 (ASIAN/LONDON) or the R1 slicer (LONDON/OVERLAP), particularly at 07:00 and 12:00 UTC?
decisions.summary: Choose the authority for session boundaries at 07:00 and 12:00 UTC.
options: Use governed V0.3 ASIAN/LONDON boundaries.
Use the R1 slicer LONDON/OVERLAP boundaries.
Keep the conflict unresolved and block replay.

consequences.option: Use governed V0.3 ASIAN/LONDON boundaries.
consequences.consequence: Events at 07:00 and 12:00 UTC are classified using V0.3 boundaries; R1 slicer outputs are not the session authority.

consequences.option: Use the R1 slicer LONDON/OVERLAP boundaries.
consequences.consequence: Events at 07:00 and 12:00 UTC follow R1 session slices; V0.3 comparisons require an explicit mapping.

consequences.option: Keep the conflict unresolved and block replay.
consequences.consequence: No session-dependent V2.1 evaluation is authorized.

decisions.title: V2.1 termination rule
decisions.question: Should the ALD family be archived with no V2.2 under the proposed kill rule: DEV pooled expectancy <= 0 OR bootstrap CI95 includes 0 OR PRE_OOS gate FAIL?
decisions.proposed_rule: archive the ALD family with no V2.2 if DEV pooled expectancy <= 0 OR bootstrap CI95 includes 0 OR PRE_OOS gate FAIL
decisions.summary: Approve, edit, or reject the proposed termination rule.
options: Accept
Edit
Reject

consequences.option: Accept
consequences.consequence: Any listed condition archives the ALD family and prohibits V2.2.

consequences.option: Edit
consequences.consequence: The edited rule must be preregistered and approved before any replay or successor design.

consequences.option: Reject
consequences.consequence: No kill rule is established; the family remains blocked from replay or successor work until another rule is approved.

decisions.title: Friction measurement venue
decisions.question: Which broker, account type, and exact terminal symbol names will define the friction evidence venue?
decisions.summary: Specify the venue identity and instrument mapping required for friction evidence.
options: Select one broker/account type and list exact terminal names for EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY, and XAUUSD.
Select a different explicitly named broker/account/symbol mapping and document its authoritative friction source.
Keep friction venue unavailable and prohibit economic claims.

consequences.option: Select one broker/account type and list exact terminal names for EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY, and XAUUSD.
consequences.consequence: Friction capture can be specified against one venue once the exact names and evidence source are supplied.

consequences.option: Select a different explicitly named broker/account/symbol mapping and document its authoritative friction source.
consequences.consequence: The alternative venue becomes the sole approved friction authority after its mapping and measurement method are preregistered.

consequences.option: Keep friction venue unavailable and prohibit economic claims.
consequences.consequence: Economic edge remains NOT_ESTIMABLE and no friction values may be substituted.

decisions.title: Confirm legacy ALD exposure timestamps
decisions.question: Are the 2025-10-05 and 2025-01-01 ALD exposure timestamps intended, or are they year typos for 2026?
decisions.summary: Confirm the two historical exposure dates without changing the append-only registry until evidence is adjudicated.
evidence: Commits 4f27640 and 705ec56 are dated 2026-10-05; 4f27640 is the V1 preregistration commit and 705ec56 contains the V1 development report.
origin/feat/fx-asian-sweep-candidate points to commit e5725c4 dated 2026-10-01; the archived screen has no committed verdict artifact.
options: Confirm the recorded 2025-10-05 and 2025-01-01 timestamps are intended historical exposure dates.
Confirm both dates are year typos for 2026 and authorize a separately evidenced append-only correction.
Leave both dates unresolved pending stronger timestamp evidence.

consequences.option: Confirm the recorded 2025-10-05 and 2025-01-01 timestamps are intended historical exposure dates.
consequences.consequence: The existing registry entries remain unchanged and the dates are treated as owner-confirmed historical knowledge dates.

consequences.option: Confirm both dates are year typos for 2026 and authorize a separately evidenced append-only correction.
consequences.consequence: A new correction record may be added only with the owner decision and commit-backed date evidence; original entries remain immutable.

consequences.option: Leave both dates unresolved pending stronger timestamp evidence.
consequences.consequence: The registry remains unchanged and these dates cannot be used as precise exposure chronology.
